name: File::FcntlLock
title: File::FcntlLock-0.22
summary: File::FcntlLock is a module to do file locking in an object oriented fashion using the fcntl(2) system call. This allows locks on parts of a file as well as on the whole file and overcomes some known problems with flock(2) , on which which Perl's flock() function is based per default.
